title: Design System: Ulinkeun — cinematic destination hero

display.purpose: Uppercase Barlow Condensed 700; base clamp is overridden at max-width 359px and min-width 640px/1024px.

card-title.purpose: Uppercase Barlow Condensed 600; 26px base, 32px from 640px, 36px from 1440px.

dialog-title.purpose: Barlow Condensed 600 heading labelled by detail-title in the native dialog.

body.purpose: Muted Geist copy, max-width 39ch; 12px base, 13px from 640px, 14px from 1440px.

button-label.purpose: Geist 600 on the amber discovery action.

motion.name: control-hover
motion.purpose: Discovery background and circular-control color/background transitions.

motion.name: card-photo-hover
motion.purpose: Portrait photo hover enlargement; reduced motion resets scale to 1.

motion.name: autoplay-countdown
motion.purpose: Countdown after playback becomes eligible. Resets on active/playing changes; transitions and image waits add to wall-clock cycle time.

motion.name: slide-base
motion.purpose: Shared GSAP base duration. Incoming scenery scale 1.045 → 1; outgoing/incoming scenery crossfade together. Child staggering can extend the timeline.

motion.name: copy-exit
motion.purpose: Outgoing children start at time zero; copy autoAlpha becomes zero at base * 0.4.

motion.name: copy-entry
motion.value: y: 28 → 0; opacity: 0 → 1; duration: base * 0.6; stagger: 0.055s; ease: power3.out
motion.purpose: Incoming copy becomes visible and child entry starts at base * 0.32.

motion.name: card-wrap
motion.purpose: Wrapping card exits, is set to its new slot at base * 0.6, then if upcoming fades in over base * 0.35 starting at base * 0.65. Other moving cards translate over the base duration.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: 0.12s base; scenery scale: 1; text y: 0; stagger: 0; immediate card placement
motion.purpose: Retains a short manual crossfade. Autoplay and playback button are disabled; CSS transition-duration becomes 0.01ms !important and scroll-behavior auto !important.

motion.name: button-active
motion.purpose: Active feedback on buttons that are not natively disabled; still present under reduced motion.

components.name: Discovery action
components.description: Static visual specimen of Temukan ceritanya. Runtime opens the native destination dialog and persists pause; natively disabled while transitioning. Minimum height 48px, not a fixed height.
components.css: .ds-discover { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; padding: 5px 5px 5px 22px; background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-paper); border: none; border-radius: 32px; min-height: 48px; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; transition: background 180ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-discover > span { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 38px; height: 38px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-paper) 25%, transparent); border-radius: 50%; } .ds-discover:hover { background: var(--color-accent-hover); } .ds-discover:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-discover:active:not(:disabled) { translate: 0 1px; } .ds-discover:disabled { opacity: 0.7; cursor: default; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-discover { transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; } }

components.name: Circular next control
components.description: Static next-arrow specimen; previous uses the mirrored arrow. Runtime pauses and navigates; aria-disabled indicates transition lock but does not remove the button from Tab order.
components.html: <button class="ds-circle" type="button" aria-label="Destinasi berikutnya" aria-disabled="false"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14m-7-7 7 7-7 7"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-circle { display: grid; place-items: center; flex-shrink: 0; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule); border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-body); cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; transition: color 180ms var(--ease-out), background 180ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-circle:hover { background: var(--color-ink); color: var(--color-paper); } .ds-circle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-circle:active:not(:disabled) { translate: 0 1px; } .ds-circle[aria-disabled="true"] { cursor: default; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-circle { transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; } }

components.name: Playback toggle
components.description: Static playing-state specimen. In React, paused/reduced shows Play and Putar carousel otomatis; otherwise Pause and Jeda carousel. aria-pressed is !paused && !reduced, independent of hover/visibility/busy suspension. Reduced motion natively disables it.
components.html: <button class="ds-playback" type="button" aria-label="Jeda carousel" aria-pressed="true"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="14" y="3" width="4" height="18" rx="1"/><rect x="6" y="3" width="4" height="18" rx="1"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-playback { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; background: none; border: none; color: var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-body); flex-shrink: 0; margin-inline: -12px; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; } .ds-playback:hover { color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-playback:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-playback:active:not(:disabled) { translate: 0 1px; } .ds-playback:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; }

components.name: Portrait destination card
components.description: Static Bromo specimen, the first upcoming card when Bali is active. Photo and object position are copied from lib/destinations.ts. Runtime positions all cards by measured stride; only fully fitting upcoming slots enter Tab order, capped at three, with an inset focus ring. This specimen does not simulate carousel state.
components.css: .ds-rail { --card-width: 160px; --card-gap: 16px; position: relative; height: 224px; touch-action: pan-y; } .ds-card { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: var(--card-width); height: 100%; text-align: left; border: 0; padding: 0; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--color-dialog); color: var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-body); transform-origin: center; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; } .ds-card > img { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: scale 500ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-card:hover > img { scale: 1.055; } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: -4px; } .ds-card:active:not(:disabled) { translate: 0 1px; } .ds-card[aria-disabled="true"] { cursor: default; } .ds-card-shade { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(0deg, color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-shade) 90%, transparent), var(--color-clear) 85%); } .ds-card-number { position: absolute; top: 16px; left: 16px; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1; padding-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-ink); } .ds-card-text { position: absolute; inset: auto 16px 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; } .ds-card-name { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 600; font-size: 26px; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-card-category { font-size: 9px; color: var(--color-muted); margin-top: 8px; } .ds-card-link { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 10px; margin-top: 14px; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-rail { --card-width: 208px; --card-gap: 20px; height: 284px; } .ds-card-name { font-size: 32px; } .ds-card-text { inset-inline: 20px; bottom: 24px; } .ds-card-category { font-size: 10px; } } @media (min-width: 1024px) { .ds-rail { --card-width: 216px; height: 312px; } } @media (min-width: 1440px) { .ds-rail { --card-width: 232px; --card-gap: 24px; height: 336px; } .ds-card-name { font-size: 36px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-card > img { transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; } .ds-card:hover > img { scale: 1; } }

components.name: Destination photo credit
components.description: Actual Bromo credit label and source link from lib/destinations.ts, normally inside the details dialog. Opens the stored source in a new tab; no author identity or license terms are inferred.
components.html: Bromo–Semeru–Batok–Widodaren · Wikimedia Commons
components.css: .ds-credit { display: inline-flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 10px; color: var(--color-ink); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; margin-top: 12px; min-height: 44px; touch-action: manipulation; } .ds-credit > svg { flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-credit:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 5px; }

narrative.northStar: A moving window into Indonesian destinations
narrative.overview:
Full-bleed destination photography establishes the cinematic setting. Warm ivory copy, amber controls, dark photographic scrims, and condensed destination names frame a right-edge portrait filmstrip. Geist carries the smaller Indonesian interface copy.

This is a code-first record of the implemented hero, including its destination-details dialog. The approved cinematic direction supplies the descriptive language; the implementation supplies the values and behavior. It is a hero-scoped system, not a specification for future pages or travel services.
keyCharacteristics: Photography remains the dominant surface, with layered scrims behind text.
Condensed uppercase destination names contrast with compact Geist interface copy.
One GSAP timeline coordinates scenery, destination copy, and filmstrip changes.
Responsive clipping and measured card visibility constrain keyboard card access.
User pause, native dialog behavior, and reduced-motion handling are implemented controls.

rules.name: The Photographic Contrast Rule
rules.body: Keep the implemented scrims with the destination photography; the text treatment is composed against these overlays, not the unshaded image.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Preserve the hero's existing gradient and opacity layering when reproducing it; no shadow vocabulary is implemented here.

dos: **Do** retain the implemented photographic scrims behind warm ivory copy.
**Do** use Barlow Condensed for destination titles and Geist for interface copy.
**Do** keep manual navigation, persistent pause, measured card Tab eligibility, and inset card focus visible.
**Do** preserve the short reduced-motion crossfade and disabled autoplay when describing current behavior.
**Do** update each demo image together with its credit and crop position in `lib/destinations.ts`.
donts: **Don't** describe the five-second countdown as the exact duration of a complete slide cycle.
**Don't** promise three fully visible cards at every viewport or a visually reordered Tab sequence.
**Don't** claim motion is entirely removed or all offscreen cards are hidden from assistive technology.
**Don't** infer photographer identities, licensing terms, or brand ownership beyond the recorded source links.
**Don't** turn destination inspiration into claims about packages, prices, availability, testimonials, or booking contacts.
